item.description:
Laytee 0.18.0
A simpler Laytee. The introduction is now three quick steps: pick your languages, allow Accessibility, then try it once by selecting a line, pressing ⌥⌘C and pasting the translation.
⌥⌘C is now the only shortcut, and Laytee only reads text when you press it. Automatic copying of every selection, per-app pausing, and the restore, copy-again and show-last shortcuts have been removed. Hold ⌥⇧ to point at or drag around text in photos, as before. Pasting into Laytee's own text fields with ⌘V now works.
